content_sections.heading: NIT Mizoram Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the NIT Mizoram Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download NIT Mizoram Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: NIT Mizoram Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available - 1 for Temporary Faculty (BS&HSS English) and 1 for Temporary Faculty (Mechanical Engineering).

content_sections.heading: NIT Mizoram Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Temporary Faculty (BS&HSS English): Ph.D. in the relevant or equivalent discipline and shall have First Class in BA and MA from recognized University/Institution. Temporary Faculty (Mechanical Engineering): Ph.D. in the relevant or equivalent discipline and shall have First Class in M.E/M.Tech and B.E/B.Tech.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NIT Mizoram Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 10-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIT Mizoram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Temporary Faculty posts at NIT Mizoram is 10th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Temporary Faculty posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for Temporary Faculty positions at the National Institute of Technology Mizoram. These are distributed across different departments as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in the relevant discipline with First Class in their Bachelor's and Master's degrees. Specific requirements for each post are detailed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Temporary Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Temporary Faculty posts will receive a fixed monthly salary of Rs. 77,000.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for NIT Mizoram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee varies by category. General/OBC candidates need to pay Rs. 500, while SC/ST candidates need to pay Rs. 200. There is no fee for PwBD and Women candidates.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the NIT Mizoram Temporary Faculty posts?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. Candidates need to send their complete bio-data and required documents to the official email address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these recruitment opportunities?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Temporary Faculty positions at NIT Mizoram will primarily involve an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any age limit for the Temporary Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify a minimum or maximum age limit for these positions. Candidates are advised to check the detailed advertisement for any specific age-related information.

faq.question: Q9. Which departments are recruiting Temporary Faculty?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for Temporary Faculty in the Department of Basic Science & Humanities and Social Sciences (BS&HSS) English and Mechanical Engineering.
